events.x: The Korean War (25 June 1950 – 27 July 1953) was an armed conflict fought on the Korean Peninsula between North Korea (Democratic People's Republic of Korea; DPRK) and South Korea (Republic of Korea; ROK) and their allies. North Korea was supported by China and the Soviet Union, while South Korea was supported by the United Nations led by the United States under the auspices of the United Nations Command (UNC). Outcome: Inconclusive. Cost: Dead: 1.6–3 million civilians; 990,968 total South Korean casualties; 1,550,000 total North Korean casualties.
